Nicaragua

  • Chorotega↗historical language area
    Connection & source
    historical language area

    Text explicitly identifies regions of Nicaragua in the historical Chorotega/Mangue language area. This entry makes no present community-organization claim.

    Historical language geography. Reviewed 2026-10-21.

    Read the supporting source ↗
  • Mayangna↗Documented community and education project location
    Connection & source
    Documented community and education project location

    UNESCO's account of its collaborative Mayangna education project explicitly identifies Mayangna communities in Nicaragua's Bosawas reserve. This is one documented community setting rather than the full distribution of Mayangna peoples.

    Public content inspected 2026-10-21. Reviewed 2026-10-21.

    Read the supporting source ↗
  • Ocanxiu (Sutiaba)↗Explicit paired name country connection
    Connection & source
    Explicit paired name country connection

    Paragraph 40 explicitly identifies 'Ocanxiu or Sutiaba' among Indigenous peoples of Nicaragua's Pacific region. It supplies both the paired-name identification and a country connection, without requiring an inference from the Sutiaba place name. Inspection: Read title page and Representation and Participation of Indigenous Peoples, paragraphs 40–42, PDF pages 19–20. The association relies on paragraph 40, not population totals or general project commitments. Limits: The public version filename indicates December 2013; no present demographic estimate is claimed. This is a broad Nicaragua finding aid and does not map communal titles, municipal boundaries, or the full historical language range. The Penn DIA map catalogue was inspected but its map image failed to load; it is not substituted for an inspected map or counted as another geographic source.

    Geographic context in a public 2013 assessment note; population context derives from the 2005 census. Reviewed 2026-10-21.

    Read the supporting source ↗

    documented community

    The actual abstract directly places Rama community language work on Nicaragua's Caribbean coast. Full article was not read for this map task.

    Nicaraguan community/language work described in 2022 abstract. Reviewed 2026-10-21.
